findings.issue: The module docstring never mentions that a base-change functor on the anti-equivalent coordinate side already exists (`TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeFunctor`), nor that this file proves no comparison with it. Every other file in this directory relates the two sides (`Basic.lean` points at `Equivalence.lean`; `Smooth.lean` states the coordinate/scheme comparison explicitly), so a reader has no way to tell whether the two base changes agree or which to use.

summary: Every declaration and the file are documented, and the affineness argument in the module docstring is accurate. Two problems: the header promises "coherence" the file does not prove, and the docstring never mentions the pre-existing coordinate-side base change on the anti-equivalent category.
